summary.plain: The international team of about 560 physicists from roughly 75 institutions in 14 countries (plus CERN) who built and run the T2K experiment.
summary.technical: International collaboration operating the T2K long-baseline neutrino experiment; formed in smaller, differently-named form in 2002 and relaunched under the name 'T2K' in 2006. About 560 members from ~75 institutes in 14 countries and CERN per the collaboration's own page (2026); a separate official institutes page lists a different, larger count (~90 institutions, 18 countries).
